# Tabler Core

PortfolioPilot vendors the compiled browser assets from `@tabler/core` 1.4.0.

- Project: https://tabler.io/
- Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tabler/core/v/1.4.0
- License: MIT
The vendored files are loaded locally. PortfolioPilot does not contact a CDN at runtime.
